prediction_text: Not bewitched. The sickness is a natural disease, not witchcraft: neither Ascendant, its lord, nor Moon is afflicted by the lord of the 12th, despite Moon going to oppose Saturn in 6th/12th giving suspicion. After the Saturn opposition the Moon applies to the lord of the Ascendant, above earth and ascending to meridian, so the patient will mend rather than die of sorcery. Time window: improvement after the Moon-Saturn opposition passes, within days (day scale for acute course).
basis: Horary bewitched test per Lilly: affliction by lord of 12th to Asc/lord/Moon required and absent = no witchcraft; Moon then to lord of Asc above earth = recovery tendency.
